title: pvBYUReader
body:
## pvBYUReader

Reads Movie.BYU geometry files (.g) into polydata made of polygons. Use it for legacy surface models in this format; companion displacement, scalar or texture files supported by vtkBYUReader are not exposed by the ParaView proxy, so only the geometry is read.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Coordinates are used as written; check the unit before combining with other data.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `BYUReader`. Identity: `sources/byureader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the BYU reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvBYUReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
